notes: From central Marmaris, dolmus and water buses run to Icmeler, Turunc and Paradise Island. For Selimiye-Bozburun and Dalyan, a car is the most practical option.
Buy boat tours from the seafront stalls the day before (about 1,000 TL, lunch included). Bring shallow-water shoes for Kizkumu.
Summer heat reaches 38°C: swim between 12:00 and 16:00 and visit the ancient cities in the morning.
Marmaris pine honey and seafood borek are local specialities. Haggling in the bazaar is normal.
Public beaches in the centre, Icmeler and Selimiye are free. Beach club sunbeds cost 300-1,000 TL.
Dalaman Airport is 1.5 hours away. The Havas airport bus leaves from the bus station.

stops.name: Marmaris Castle
stops.tips: Suleiman the Magnificent's fortress with a small archaeology museum. It's cool in the morning, with marina views from the walls. Museum Pass accepted.

stops.name: Marmaris Bazaar
stops.tips: The old bazaar below the castle sells honey, leather and textiles. Haggling is normal.

stops.name: Icmeler Beach
stops.tips: A 15-minute dolmus (shared minibus) ride from Marmaris. The bay is shallow, calm and clean, sunbeds cost extra, and there is a free public beach section.

stops.name: Icmeler Bazaar Fish Restaurant
stops.tips: Fish and meze on the Icmeler seafront. Good for a late lunch after the beach.

stops.name: Marmaris Netsel Marina
stops.tips: Stroll the marina for yachts, cafes and sunset, with restaurants for dinner.

backups.name: Marmaris Fishermen's Harbour Restaurant
backups.tips: A fish restaurant in the centre.

backups.name: Marmaris Public Beach
backups.tips: A free beach on the central seafront and an alternative to Icmeler.

days.theme: Boat trip: Kizkumu, Selimiye and Orhaniye

stops.name: Kizkumu Beach
stops.tips: Take the 09:30 boat from Marmaris (about 1,000 TL, lunch and drinks included). It's a sandbar in the middle of the sea in Orhaniye Bay, where you walk 600 m through the water.

stops.name: Selimiye Bay
stops.tips: Lunch and swimming on the boat. The bay is calm, with a village jetty.

stops.name: Cleopatra Island
stops.tips: The last swim stop, with a small island and clear water. The return is at 18:00.

stops.name: Marmaris Kordon Fish Restaurant
stops.tips: Fish along the seafront strip. A good evening option after the boat trip.

backups.name: Rabbit Island
backups.tips: An alternative island stop on the tour route.

stops.name: Turunc Beach
stops.tips: 30 minutes from Marmaris by dolmus or water bus. A pine-scented bay with deep, clear water. Sunbeds cost extra.

stops.name: Turunc Seafront Restaurant
stops.tips: Grilled fish and meze on the seafront.

stops.name: Kumlubuk Beach
stops.tips: A quieter sandy bay behind Turunc. Swim at sunset.

stops.name: Amos Ancient City
stops.tips: A hill above Kumlubuk with a theatre and sunset views. Allow a 20-minute climb.

backups.name: Turunc Village Breakfast
backups.tips: Gozleme (stuffed flatbread) in a village house.

backups.name: Turunc Waterfall
backups.tips: A small waterfall behind the village, reached on foot.

stops.name: Selimiye Village
stops.tips: A fishing village on the Bozburun Peninsula with stone houses, a marina and a quiet bay. Stop for coffee.

stops.name: Selimiye Public Beach
stops.tips: The village beach, with calm water and free entry.

stops.name: Sardunya Restaurant Selimiye
stops.tips: Selimiye's seafront restaurant, serving seafood borek (filled pastry) and meze.

stops.name: Bozburun Marina
stops.tips: A village known for its wooden gulet boatyards. Walk the marina at sunset.

backups.name: Sogut Village Beach
backups.tips: A quiet village beach beyond Bozburun.

stops.name: Gunnucek Nature Park
stops.tips: A forest of sweetgum trees next to Marmaris. Walk in the morning for the shade.

stops.name: Paradise Island Beach
stops.tips: Reach it by water bus from Marmaris or by car. There is a bay and a beach club, with boats to the Phosphorescent Cave.

stops.name: Paradise Island Restaurant
stops.tips: The island restaurant serves grills and salads.

stops.name: Marmaris Ataturk Statue Beach
stops.tips: An evening walk on the central seafront, with ice cream and sunset.

backups.name: Marmaris Bazaar Kofte Restaurant
backups.tips: Kofte with piyaz (bean salad) in the bazaar.

backups.name: Nimara Cave
backups.tips: A prehistoric cave on Paradise Island, reached on foot.

stops.name: Kaunos Ancient City
stops.tips: 1.5 hours from Marmaris. A Carian city reached by boat from Dalyan, with rock tombs across the river.

stops.name: Iztuzu Beach
stops.tips: A loggerhead turtle (caretta) nesting beach with 4.5 km of sand. Sunbeds cost extra, you can come by boat or dolmus, and shade is scarce.

stops.name: Dalyan Bazaar Fish Restaurant
stops.tips: Fish beside the Dalyan river, with a view of the rock tombs.

stops.name: Dalyan Rock Tombs
stops.tips: Lycian rock tombs seen from the riverbank. A good photo spot.

backups.name: Dalyan Mud Baths
backups.tips: The Sultaniye hot springs and mud, as an alternative to the beach.

days.theme: Marmaris morning and a gentle goodbye

stops.name: Marmaris Friday Market
stops.tips: On a Friday, expect a big market (honey, herbs, textiles). Otherwise, head to the Marmaris covered bazaar.

stops.name: Marmaris Honey House
stops.tips: Taste and buy Marmaris pine honey, with breakfast.

stops.name: Marmaris Seafront Promenade
stops.tips: One last walk from the castle to the marina.

stops.name: Marmaris Kordon Tea Garden
stops.tips: Tea and toast by the sea for a farewell.
